name: FFALCON r34a0
summary: FFALCON r34a0 ships with preloaded apps and a boot ad on old Android 5.1. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This FFALCON r34a0 is a China-market TV on old Android 5.1 with only 1 GB of memory and 8 GB of storage. It has preloaded apps that can be hidden, and a boot ad. The list is short, at 22 apps, and applies only to this firmware.

Here is what is known about testing it. The firmware refuses the usual way of turning apps off, so apps are hidden instead, and a new home screen app will not install. TidyTV can only debloat this set, over Wi-Fi, with a backup first and nothing deleted.
keep: The TV's built-in apps that are not on the list
notes: This firmware denies the usual way of turning apps off, so the list hides them instead and undoing it uses a different command.
New home screens are refused, so only the stock CyberUI home screen can be used.
Installing apps from a computer is blocked until two settings are switched on.

faq.q: Can I put a new home screen on my FFALCON r34a0?
faq.a: No. This firmware refuses any home screen app, so the stock CyberUI home screen stays.

faq.q: Is this model handled the same way as others?
faq.a: No. This old Android 5.1 firmware refuses the normal setting, so apps are hidden instead. It was tested on one unit on 21 October 2026.
Yes. Hidden apps can be unhidden, and Restore everything in the app turns every app TidyTV changed back on.
